title: The Queue Before Opening
logline: The muffin stall opens at the third bell. The pair arrives first and must fill the waiting. Queue games are invented; Nimbus's impatience-drip threatens the paper menu sign.
starting_goal: Wait for the stall to open without losing the morning to boredom
friction_source: A fixed external clock versus two different boredom tolerances
character_want: Nimbus: wanted — the wait is only bearable if it's play; Pip: competent-wanted — the queue order must be honored correctly
power_usage: Impatience-drip spots the menu sign; the sign is saved by re-purposing the spots as today's flavors
escalation: Escalation by kind: counting games -> shadow-tag within queue rules -> a spot-the-difference duel across the stall front that almost misses the opening bell
emotional_beat: The stall opens mid-game; they finish the game before ordering, and the waiting games are requested by name next week
rewatch_detail: The queue behind them grows one shadow at a time in the background — the community arrives silently
distinctness_note: Waiting as co-created play; the deadline is not beaten, just inhabited well

title: Stop Digging Up the Seed
logline: A planted seed shows nothing for days. Pip checks daily, then twice daily, then digs a careful look. The seedling survives the inspection, barely. Some waiting cannot be watched.
starting_goal: Help a new seed sprout
friction_source: Care expressed as verification kills the thing verified
character_want: Pip: competent-wanted — an unchecked process is his specific torture; the map cannot record what he cannot see
power_usage: None — and Nimbus's watering is correctly restrained throughout
escalation: Escalation by kind: daily chart -> twice-daily -> the careful excavation, conducted with the tenderness of surgery and the effect of an earthquake
emotional_beat: They agree on a no-peeking pact sealed with a pebble on the marker stick; the sprout arrives unobserved, on its own morning, and is greeted like news
rewatch_detail: The marker stick's pebble count changes only once — on the morning of the sprout
distinctness_note: Pip's flaw is the engine (checking-as-caring); Nimbus is the restraint model — agency inversion by design

title: Rainy-Day Drop Races
logline: The world's rain closes the garden. Under the shelter: drop races down the window-leaf, commentary, championships. When the sun returns, the end of the rain is almost a disappointment.
starting_goal: Wait out the world's rain under the shelter
friction_source: Open-ended waiting with no clock at all
character_want: Both: wanted — the day feels stolen unless they steal it back
power_usage: None; the rain is the world's and Nimbus enjoys being off-duty in it
escalation: Escalation by kind: drop races -> league tables -> a championship final interrupted by sunshine, which is booed gently, then welcomed anyway
emotional_beat: The league table is nailed inside the shelter 'for next rain'; the shelter becomes a place you hope to need
rewatch_detail: The drop-race league table fills in legibly across the episode and matches the on-screen race outcomes
distinctness_note: The weather episode where nobody's power matters; waiting converted to ritual; rain reframed as venue

title: The Dough Rises on Its Own
logline: Muffin dough must rise; checking it deflates it. Two friends guard a bowl from their own curiosity for one whole hour, armed with games and mutual surveillance.
starting_goal: Let the muffin dough rise undisturbed
friction_source: The process works only when unwatched; both are watchers
character_want: Both: competent-wanted — the stall trusts their muffins; opening the lid early is a visible, smellable failure
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: peek negotiations -> a mirror rigged to peek 'without lifting the lid' (it lifts) -> sitting on their hands and humming the waiting hum until the hour rings
emotional_beat: The dough doubles; the muffins rise; the waiting hum is written on the recipe card as an official ingredient
rewatch_detail: The dough's dome rises measurably in the background of every scene
distinctness_note: Biological time as the immovable object; the comedy is self-surveillance, not weather

title: The Sour Test
logline: The apples look ready. They are not. One brave test bite says so, twice. Nimbus cannot hurry ripening — he has no sun in him — and learning that his powers end is its own growing up.
starting_goal: Know when the apples are ready
friction_source: Ripeness runs on tree-time; the power set contains nothing that touches it
character_want: Nimbus: needed — if he can't hurry the apples he must find another way to matter to the harvest
power_usage: Explicitly unavailable: no warmth power exists; the limit is stated by events, not narration
escalation: Escalation by kind: look-test -> sniff-test -> the twice-bitten sour faces -> a ripeness calendar drawn from the tree's own clues (color give, stem ease)
emotional_beat: Nimbus's contribution is found: his gentle mist keeps dust off the ripening fruit; waiting well became his job
rewatch_detail: The test apple's two bite marks are visible on the compost pile in later scenes
distinctness_note: Power-limit as theme: the honest discovery of what he cannot do, answered with what he can

title: Whistle Lessons
logline: Nimbus whistles beautifully through a reed and a held gust. Pip cannot. Teacher and student swap; the planner meets a skill no checklist can hold.
starting_goal: Pip wants to learn Nimbus's reed-whistle
friction_source: A skill that lives in a different kind of body; imitation hits anatomy
character_want: Pip: wanted — being bad at something in front of Nimbus is his nightmare; Nimbus: needed — teaching is his first time being the capable one
power_usage: The whistle exists only through Nimbus's controlled micro-gust; Pip's failure is anatomical, not moral
escalation: Escalation by kind: posture adjustments -> reed taxonomy -> Pip's whistle producing only wind-noise while Nimbus's modesty crumbles into visible, forgiven pride
emotional_beat: Pip finds his own instrument — a grass-blade hum — and the two sounds duet badly, then well
rewatch_detail: The duet's rhythm is the reconciliation motif from the apology episode, played faster
distinctness_note: Skill asymmetry honest to bodies; Nimbus as teacher inverts the competence corridor

title: The Petal Mural
logline: A mural of petals on the path, assembled petal by petal. Breathing near it is a hazard. Nimbus's held breath becomes a hiccup; the hiccup becomes a gust; the mural becomes weather.
starting_goal: Assemble the petal mural for community day
friction_source: A fragile slow artwork in the workspace of a creature made of breath
character_want: Nimbus: needed — holding still is the contribution; the body votes otherwise
power_usage: The hiccup-gust scatters the petals; any breath works, his is bigger and funnier
escalation: Escalation by kind: tiptoe protocols -> breath-holding -> the hiccup disaster -> pasting-as-you-go so nothing is left loose to lose
emotional_beat: The finished mural wears its re-laid corner proudly; the process change is credited to 'the hiccup' on the plan board
rewatch_detail: The mural's image is the friendship-edge pattern from the border episode, grown large
distinctness_note: Suppression fails through the body, not the will; process invention as the resolution

title: Teaching the Snail to Come
logline: A hum, a lettuce leaf, and a hypothesis: can the snail learn to come when called? Weeks of one afternoon. Progress measured in leaf-markers. The answer arrives at snail tempo.
starting_goal: Teach the snail to come when the hum is hummed
friction_source: Habituation operates on the animal's clock, not the trainers'
character_want: Both: needed — being answered by a wild thing is belonging from the world itself
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: daily trials -> charted non-progress -> abandoning the chart one day and simply humming together, which is when the snail first turns
emotional_beat: The snail comes — eventually, approximately, on its own terms; the hum becomes the garden's gathering call anyway
rewatch_detail: The trial chart's distances shrink almost imperceptibly scene by scene; the trend is real but tiny
distinctness_note: Training as relationship rather than control; the method succeeds exactly when it stops being a method

title: The Dark Shed
logline: The watering cans are in the shed; the shed is dark. Pip volunteers, retreats, and returns with a schedule for entering. Nimbus's nervous mist makes the dark thicker.
starting_goal: Fetch the watering cans from the dark shed
friction_source: An ordinary dark place plus two imaginations, one of which fogs when afraid
character_want: Pip: competent-wanted — a planner defeated by a room is intolerable; Nimbus: needed — his fear-fog makes him the wrong escort, or so he fears
power_usage: Fear-mist thickens the dark (expressive leak under stress); the visibility problem IS the emotion made air
escalation: Escalation by kind: schedule for entry -> rope lifeline -> the mist rolling out like the shed is breathing -> both admitting fear out loud, which thins the mist immediately
emotional_beat: Inside: one wheelbarrow, two cans, zero monsters; the door is left open and the schedule is retired unlaminated
rewatch_detail: The 'monster shape' is visible as the wheelbarrow in the first shed shot — fair play for rewatchers
distinctness_note: Fear shared is fear halved, rendered literally in the air; Pip is the frightened one — inversion honored

title: The Night Rumble
logline: A deep rumble crosses the night garden. Daylight theories are brave; midnight listening is not. The investigation finds the mill wheel turning with the night stream.
starting_goal: Identify the night rumble
friction_source: An unknown sound scales with darkness; theories scale faster
character_want: Both: wanted — neither wants to be the one who is scared; both are
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: theory board -> bravery pact -> the slow approach with linked arms, which makes four-legged silhouettes on the path
emotional_beat: The mill wheel is greeted formally; the night sound becomes 'the mill saying goodnight' and stops being the enemy
rewatch_detail: The rumble syncs visibly with the stream's faster glints — the clue is shown from the start
distinctness_note: Shared fear without a rescuer; explanation as comfort, delivered by observation

title: A Cloud in the Rain
logline: Nimbus has never stood in the world's rain. What if it hurts? What if he melts? Pip goes with him. The first drop tickles. The rest is giggles.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to experience the world's rain once, safely
friction_source: Fear of his own element in its wild form
character_want: Nimbus: wanted — courage witnessed is courage doubled; Pip: needed — accompaniment is the one supply that matters
power_usage: The premise is a cloud body meeting non-cloud weather; nothing is deployed, everything is felt
escalation: Escalation by kind: edge-hovering -> one arm of mist extended -> full immersion and the discovery that wild rain is loud, cold, and hilarious
emotional_beat: Afterward he asks for a towel, which is absurd for a cloud, and receives one, which is friendship
rewatch_detail: Pip silently moves the towel closer scene by scene before it is asked for
distinctness_note: The identity's literal substance meets its wild origin; courage episode with zero antagonist

title: The High Tangle
logline: The kite string is tangled at the top of the hill pine. Nimbus can float up but the branches need hands. Pip must climb — and Pip does not do heights. Escort, not rescue.
starting_goal: Untangle the kite string from the high pine
friction_source: The job needs the groundling's hands at the cloud's altitude
character_want: Pip: competent-wanted — the skills are his but the height isn't; Nimbus: needed — he cannot do it FOR Pip, only WITH him
power_usage: Nimbus floats alongside as company and soft landing-spot promise; he never lifts Pip (carrying is beyond his mild set and stays beyond it)
escalation: Escalation by kind: ladder talk (no ladder) -> branch-by-branch plan -> the pause halfway up where Nimbus tells the worst joke in the world on purpose
emotional_beat: The string comes free; the descent is slower than the climb and nobody mentions it; the kite is re-flown that same hour, lower
rewatch_detail: Nimbus positions himself under Pip's branch in every shot — the safety net that is never used and always there
distinctness_note: Escort-not-rescue dramatizes DEC-0016's balance rule; the power deliberately does less than it could

title: The Night Shift
logline: Something rustles the lettuce at night. Flashlight, plan, courage. The rustler is the snail — snails work nights. The garden's night shift is met, catalogued, and left in peace.
starting_goal: Investigate the night rustling
friction_source: An unknown nighttime agent; imagination outbids evidence
character_want: Both: needed — the garden is theirs to keep; the night is not theirs and must be respected
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: theory chart -> ambush plan with snacks -> the beam of the jar-lamp finding one unbothered snail, mid-shift, deserving an apology lettuce
emotional_beat: The night map is drawn: who works when; the pair's own bedtime is added to it, officially
rewatch_detail: The rustling's rhythm matches the snail's eating pace from the daytime episodes
distinctness_note: Fear resolved into ecology; the world at night is staffed, not haunted

title: Bring Ten
logline: A world-rain smudges the stall's note. 'Bring ten' — ten what? Pebbles seems plausible at the time. The stall needed planks. The error is delivered with pride.
starting_goal: Fulfill the stall's smudged request
friction_source: A damaged message plus a willingness to guess
character_want: Both: trusted — being errand-runners for the stall is a badge; asking for clarification feels like losing it
power_usage: None; the smudging rain was the world's
escalation: Escalation by kind: candidate-guess list -> pebble selection ceremony -> delivery of ten excellent pebbles to a baffled stall note-writer
emotional_beat: The stall's reply note says the pebbles are perfect for the path edge; planks are re-requested, spelled bigger; both deliveries stand
rewatch_detail: The smudged word's visible letters actually support both readings — rewatchers can adjudicate
distinctness_note: Miscommunication from physics (water on ink), not foolishness; guessing honored as effort, corrected without shame

title: A Moment, Misunderstood
logline: Pip says he needs a moment. Nimbus hears 'I need less of you'. Withdrawal breeds fog; fog breeds more withdrawal. The fix is one direct sentence, finally asked.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to respond rightly to Pip's request for a moment alone
friction_source: A boundary heard as a rejection; a feeling that fogs the air between them
character_want: Nimbus: not a burden — his fear says leaving is the only kind move; Pip: wanted — solitude requested, not distance
power_usage: Nimbus's withdrawal fog visibly follows his retreat; the audience tracks the misunderstanding by weather
escalation: Escalation by kind: polite distance -> exaggerated politeness -> the fog filling the garden path between their two spots until Pip walks through it to ask
emotional_beat: The sentence 'a moment is not a door' is said once and never needs repeating; the fog lifts unevenly, honestly
rewatch_detail: The fog's edge retreats scene by scene after the talk — a slow visible mend
distinctness_note: The relationship itself is the stakes; weather as the visible distance between two people

title: The Muffins Nobody Ate
logline: A basket of muffins arrives with no note. Each friend assumes they are for the other. Etiquette forbids eating someone else's gift. The muffins go stale politely.
starting_goal: Do the right thing with an unlabeled gift
friction_source: Two parallel polite assumptions locking the gift in place
character_want: Both: wanted — eating the other's gift would be theft of a kindness
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: admiring the basket -> guarding it -> each baking a SMALLER batch for the other to make eating the first batch permissible, producing four batches
emotional_beat: The sender's second note ('for BOTH of you, eat them TODAY') arrives one day too late; the stale muffins are crumbled ceremonially for the birds, and the four fresh batches feed the stall queue
rewatch_detail: The basket's bow is tied in the stall's signature knot — visible from scene one to anyone who knows knots
distinctness_note: Double-blind courtesy as mechanism; abundance generated by restraint

title: The Slow Day
logline: Nimbus spends a day imitating the snail: slow on purpose. Pip misreads the stillness as illness and wraps the day in blankets, soup, and worry.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to try the snail's slow way for one day
friction_source: A chosen behavior pattern is indistinguishable from a symptom
character_want: Nimbus: wanted — slowness as exploration; Pip: needed — caring for a friend who is not actually in need
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: concerned hovering -> broth -> a blanket fort around a perfectly healthy cloud whose slow blink is read as brave endurance
emotional_beat: The truth lands; Pip is embarrassed; Nimbus spends the next day at Pip speed in apology, and both agree: own pace, announced in advance
rewatch_detail: The snail watches the entire episode from the lettuce, unhurried, like a teacher grading
distinctness_note: Misread wellness instead of misread illness would be nothing; here care overshoots because the signals were honestly ambiguous

title: The Wave That Meant Hello
logline: Pip waves at the downstream friend across the field. Nimbus reads the semaphore wrong and arrives rain-ready, soaking the picnic cloth. The apology teaches them both a signals chart.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to answer Pip's signal correctly
friction_source: A greeting and a summons share a vocabulary of arms
character_want: Nimbus: needed — arriving rain-ready to a hello is the exact shape of his fear; Pip: wanted — his wave caused a soaking
power_usage: The ready-rain arrives with the misreading; the wet cloth is the cost of ambiguity
escalation: Escalation by kind: the wave -> the sprint with full rain load -> the soak -> the drying of both cloth and dignity, side by side
emotional_beat: They invent two signals only they use: one for hello, one for help; the chart lives on the boathouse door
rewatch_detail: The two signals are drilled in the final scene and reused in later episodes without comment
distinctness_note: The pair builds shared language as the resolution — world-building through a mistake

title: The Fern That Wanted Neglect
logline: The fern wilts. More water, more wilt. The hard truth: it is drowning in kindness. Nimbus's rain is not always love; sometimes love is the watering can put down.
starting_goal: Save the wilting fern
friction_source: The patient's need is the opposite of the helper's instinct
character_want: Nimbus: needed — his whole belonging strategy (water = help) is the poison here; identity-level crisis in miniature
power_usage: Overwatering by drizzle is the harm; the power must be deliberately NOT used, on purpose, with effort
escalation: Escalation by kind: drizzle -> deeper wilt -> desperate bigger drizzle -> the discovery (via the garden book's drawing) that roots also breathe
emotional_beat: They mark the fern 'DO NOT WATER' and visit it daily to do nothing; recovery arrives as a single uncurled frond, celebrated like a parade
rewatch_detail: The frond uncurls measurably across the final three scenes
distinctness_note: The power as the harm, restraint as the care; identity drama through horticulture

title: The Sick-Day Protocol
logline: Pip has a cold. Nimbus nurses: mist therapy, soup via the stall, and zero respect for rest. Being cared for badly by someone you love is its own curriculum.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to nurse Pip through a cold
friction_source: Care oversupplied becomes another symptom
character_want: Pip: competent-wanted — helplessness embarrasses him; Nimbus: needed — nursing is the ultimate helping, and overdoing it is the risk
power_usage: Cool mist on a forehead is genuinely right; seventeen consecutive mistings is not
escalation: Escalation by kind: mist -> blanket mountain -> whispering so quietly that Pip must sit up to hear, defeating the lying down
emotional_beat: Pip croaks the one-word request 'sit'; Nimbus sits; the cold leaves on schedule, and the sitting is remembered as the medicine
rewatch_detail: The blanket mountain gains one blanket per scene until it has its own weather (a tiny mist cap)
distinctness_note: Care calibration between unequal needs; the sick character's agency protected (he directs the care)

title: Reading the Stream's Mood
logline: After the windy night the stream's voice is wrong again. This time Nimbus reads it — the way Pip reads him — and finds the leaf-mat blockage by sound alone.
starting_goal: Find and clear what is troubling the stream
friction_source: Diagnosis by ear; the stream cannot point
character_want: Nimbus: needed — the reading skill, turned outward, is his new craft; Pip: competent-wanted — teaching the reader becomes the student's teacher
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: sound chart of stream-moods -> walking the bank with the chart -> locating the blockage where the chart says 'tired'
emotional_beat: The stream's voice recovers mid-clear; the chart is pinned with the instruments, authored jointly
rewatch_detail: Each stream-mood entry on the chart matches a sound heard in an earlier episode
distinctness_note: The signature skill (reading states) transfers from friend to world; caretaking as applied empathy

title: The Tree Is Not Dying
logline: The old tree's bark is flaking. Alarm: medicine plans, a watering rota, a vigil. Observation wins: this tree sheds bark like the snail sheds nothing, on purpose, seasonally.
starting_goal: Find out whether the old tree is sick
friction_source: A healthy process that looks like decline
character_want: Both: needed — the tree shades everyone; losing it is unthinkable, so it must not be lost
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: worry -> rota -> the vigil at which the new bark is finally seen shining underneath, mid-vigil
emotional_beat: The shed bark is gathered into a mulch ring as thanks; the tree's page in the garden book gets a gold star and the word 'molting'
rewatch_detail: The new bark's pale edge is visible under a flake in scene two — evidence before interpretation
distinctness_note: Misdiagnosis of a living thing resolved by observation, not intervention; the vigil becomes gratitude

title: The Crack Sprout Stays
logline: The escorted seed (3020's legacy — the crack by the path) has sprouted. A pot would be kinder. Or would it? The pair debates relocating versus adapting the world, and the path bends again.
starting_goal: Decide the sprout's future: move it or protect it in place
friction_source: Two care theories: relocation to safety versus respect for the chosen place
character_want: Pip: competent-wanted — the pot plan is clean; Nimbus: needed — the sprout chose its crack; honoring choice is help too
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: pros-cons board -> relocation forms drafted in triplicate -> watching the sprout lean toward the path's light and simply deciding
emotional_beat: The path officially bends around the crack; the forms become compost; the sprout gets a tiny fence with a gate it will never use
rewatch_detail: The sprout's lean direction matches the morning sun's path established in earlier scenes
distinctness_note: Care as non-intervention with paperwork abandoned; continuity with the seed-escort episode pays off

title: Delivery Morning
logline: The stall's delivery morning: butter to keep cool, flour to keep dry, orders to keep straight. Nimbus's chill-mist is perfect for butter; his hurry-gusts are disastrous for flour. Calibration of help by task, not by heart.
starting_goal: Complete the stall's delivery checklist correctly
friction_source: Two adjacent tasks need opposite Nimbus settings
character_want: Nimbus: needed — the checklist is trust made paper; Pip: competent-wanted — the order is his system
power_usage: Chill-mist and hurry-gusts are both him; matching the setting to the task is the skill being learned
escalation: Escalation by kind: hurry-gust flour cloud -> re-sorted orders -> a task-to-setting matching chart invented mid-morning and immediately working
emotional_beat: The checklist returns with one flour-cloud drawing in the margin and the words 'same time next week'
rewatch_detail: The margin drawing is added by the stall-keeper on-screen at the end — approval, not complaint
distinctness_note: Same character, opposite correct behaviors per task; the leak calibrated rather than cured

title: Helping Pip Be Funny
logline: Nimbus gets the laughs; Pip plans the lists. Today Pip wants a laugh of his own. Scripted jokes die on the page. What lands is Pip's flat reading of the shopping list.
starting_goal: Pip wants to make Nimbus laugh once, on purpose
friction_source: Comedy resists procedure; the attempt to schedule a laugh guarantees none
character_want: Pip: wanted — 'boring' is the fear; a single earned laugh would disprove it
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: joke cards -> prop-based bit involving three pebbles -> an increasingly desperate delivery while Nimbus holds his laugh-supportive face, which is its own comedy
emotional_beat: The deadpan list-reading cracks Nimbus completely; Pip pretends it was planned; Nimbus lets him keep the win; the list becomes a recurring bit
rewatch_detail: Nimbus's supportive smile tightens measurably across the failed jokes — the audience's comedy gauge
distinctness_note: Pip's belonging-fear episode; humor discovered as voice, not technique; zero weather

title: Sending the Sound of Rain
logline: The downstream pen-pal asks: what does your rain sound like? Sound cannot be mailed. The pair invents a drawn rhythm-notation; the friend mails back the sound of their stream, in dots.
starting_goal: Answer the pen-pal's question across distance without technology
friction_source: A sensory question across a sensory gap
character_want: Nimbus: needed — his rain is worth asking about! Pip: competent-wanted — a notation system is his love language
power_usage: The rain's sound is the content; Nimbus performs drizzle rhythms on purpose for transcription
escalation: Escalation by kind: describing in words (fails) -> tapping patterns (better) -> the dot-and-line score that the friend performs on their own roof and mails back
emotional_beat: The returned notation, performed, sounds like a bigger stream saying hello; two weather systems correspond
rewatch_detail: The notation actually scans: a rewatching child can tap the rhythms shown
distinctness_note: Communication invention as plot; the world enlarges through correspondence, not cast

title: The Surprise Chores
logline: Nimbus does Pip's morning chores before dawn, Nimbus-style: piles where files go, grouped by vibe. Gratitude wrestles system-loss. The treaty: one shelf, forever unsorted, by law.
starting_goal: Nimbus wants to gift Pip a chore-free morning
friction_source: Help performed in the helper's idiom, not the helped one's
character_want: Nimbus: needed — the surprise must land; Pip: wanted — his systems are how he feels safe, and love just reorganized them
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: waking to done chores (joy) -> finding the piles (horror) -> restacking while pretending not to restack, caught mid-pile
emotional_beat: The treaty is signed: one 'cloud shelf' where Nimbus's order rules and Pip may not look; it becomes the most-used shelf
rewatch_detail: The pile-organization logic is actually consistent (by softness); a rewatching child can crack Nimbus's system
distinctness_note: Gifted help with a compatibility tax; the resolution codifies difference instead of curing it

title: The Bee Ferry
logline: A tired bee, far from the flowers. The answer is a leaf-boat ferry with a world's-breeze sail. The passengers' manifest is one; the crew's pride is enormous.
starting_goal: Carry a tired bee to the flower bank
friction_source: A passenger too small for any vehicle, too important for none
character_want: Nimbus: needed — the smallest possible passenger at the smallest possible scale of help
power_usage: None — the sail catches the world's breeze; Nimbus is crew, not engine
escalation: Escalation by kind: boarding diplomacy -> ballast disputes (the bee weighs nothing, the crew argues anyway) -> a landing among clover with full ceremony
emotional_beat: The bee rests, then buzzes off mid-thanks; the ferry is kept moored 'in case of bees'
rewatch_detail: The bee's wing-speed visibly recovers across the voyage — the health gauge is animated
distinctness_note: Help at smallest scale treated with full ceremony; the helped party leaves without gratitude, which is fine

title: The Borrowed Pennant
logline: The stall lends its parade pennant for the day. It snags; a seam frays. Returning it honestly, with the repair offered before the excuse, is the whole test of the day.
starting_goal: Return the borrowed pennant in lent condition
friction_source: A borrowed precious thing damaged on your watch
character_want: Both: trusted — the loan was the honor; the fray is the audit
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: hiding the fray (unbearable, one scene) -> repair attempt with the big needles -> walking to the stall with the truth held out in front like a flag
emotional_beat: The stall accepts the fray and the repair, and re-lends the pennant for next week — trust reissued, visibly
rewatch_detail: The fray is caused on screen, plainly, in a scene whose setup viewers will re-watch to confirm fairness
distinctness_note: Borrowed-trust drama with no weather; honesty rewarded by re-lending rather than absolution

title: The Week of the Clear Path
logline: The pair promises to keep the path clear all week. Day five is tired. One skipped twig detours the snail. Nobody saw the shortcut — except the two who took it.
starting_goal: Keep the path clear for a full week
friction_source: A promise sustained across fatigue, witnessed by nobody
character_want: Both: trusted — the promise is to the path's users, most of whom never know
power_usage: None
escalation: Escalation by kind: enthusiastic day one -> routine day three -> the corner-cut day five, immediately re-done at dusk without being asked
emotional_beat: The week ends with a self-awarded badge: 'mostly'; the badge is pinned where only they can see it, which is the point
rewatch_detail: Day five's skipped twig is foregrounded in its scene and conspicuously gone after dusk
distinctness_note: Integrity as a private event; the reward is self-awarded and the slip is self-corrected
